purpose: Smooth motion with an explicit acceleration limit.
description: Provides a means to, with both a continuous position and velocity, accelerate from its current position to a target position in minimum time given a maximum acceleration. See [Spring] for another version of this. Author: TreyReynolds/AxisAngles
